blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A progressive group is seeking the assistance of the National Police Commission (Napolcom) in tracking and retrieving the mobile phones of two activists allegedly stolen during a martial law rally, which were traced from Camp Crame in Quezon City to Greenhills in San Juan City. In a letter dated Wednesday, Sept. 23, and addressed to Napolcom Commissioner Rafael Calinisan, the Samahan ng Progresibong Kabataan (SPARK) said the missing mobile phones—an iPhone 15 Plus and Vivo Y19s—belonged to two student activists from the University of the Philippines and Rizal Technological University who joined the Martial Law rally on Monday, […]...
